item.title: NHL: Boston Bruins +1.5 -225 at DraftKings (Low, +5.7 pts)
item.description:
NHL · Boston Bruins @ Detroit Red Wings · Wed Nov 18, 7:40 PM ET

Puck line: Boston Bruins +1.5 at -225 (DraftKings). Our probability 74.9% from game data, the price implies 69.2%, edge +5.7 pts, EV +8.2% per unit. Confidence: Lean.

Our probability at +1.5 is 74.9%, from the game data: this season's results and margins, recent form, rest, the injury report and home edge (projected margin -0.3 for the home side). DraftKings offers -225, which implies only 69.2%. Its bar is 5.5 points: the model's own margin of error on this side, with 20 games behind the thinner team (±0.44 goals on the margin). It clears it by 0.2. Not graded against other books' prices; for reference the market makes it 67.3%.

What supports it:

  • Detroit Red Wings rate -0.2 a game over 21 (8-13), Boston Bruins +0.4 over 20 (13-7); last season -0.2 and +0.3 a game.
  • Detroit Red Wings trending: last five -1 vs -0.3 on the season.
  • Boston Bruins are rested (4 days).
  • Detroit Red Wings without Albert Johansson (D), Dylan Larkin (C) (-0.2).
  • Detroit Red Wings have William Wallinder (D) listed day-to-day or questionable.
  • Projected margin +0.3 for Boston Bruins against +1.5.

What could go wrong:

  • Boston Bruins trending: last five +0.2 vs +1 on the season.
  • Home edge +0.2 for Detroit Red Wings.
  • Detroit Red Wings are rested (4 days).
  • Boston Bruins without James Hagens (C) (+0.1).

Verdict: The game data lines up behind this side at this price.
